notes: Summary: Verdant Sentry AI (EU-headquartered grid/energy operator) evaluated Redwood Private for secure on-prem/VPC inference. High security bar: SOC2 Type II + ISO27001 + EU data residency + KMS integration. We ran demo (12/10), sent full security questionnaire (1/5). InfoSec lead Lukas Meyer declined to share the unredacted SOC2 Type II report citing auditor NDAs and internal policy; offered a redacted attestation letter only. Procurement required full evidence for our private deployment checklist. Competitor NimbusAI provided a formal attestation and demonstrated a KMS plugin pattern that fit Verdant's vendor onboarding. Procurement prioritized attestation + proof of KMS flow over bundling features. Outcome: security review flagged 'insufficient evidence' and ISO documentation gaps. No internal champion remained after procurement deferred to InfoSec. AE attempted remediation (offer NDA, staged access, remote audit assist) but legal constraints prevented sharing. Closed-lost — reason: security attestation mismatch / unwillingness to share SOC2 evidence; competitor satisfied that requirement. Action items: send standard loss survey, attach Redwood security FAQ + redacted SOC2 summary, mark "reopen if SOC2 evidence provided" on account record.
